reason: bind deterministic cache, training, projection, and Stage-A evaluation mechanics before any focused-cache outcome is observed

cache_contract.candidate_order: P11 slot-10 incumbent first, then C100 indices 10 through 99 in ascending index order
cache_contract.metadata: numeric session ordinal, turn index, hard/control cohort flag, outer fold, and inner fold are grouping/training-label metadata only and are never model features
cache_contract.identity_scan: all cache files must contain zero complete ASIN-shaped tokens
cache_contract.write_policy: new local ignored output directory; exclusive writes; tracked manifest contains paths, shapes, byte counts, and hashes only

cohort_contract.target_allowed: positive_index is nonnegative and is either the incumbent index or in [10,99]
cohort_contract.hard_session: frozen current policy miss with at least one eligible target-allowed turn
cohort_contract.hard_groups: all eligible target-allowed turns from each hard session
cohort_contract.control_session: frozen current policy hit whose first hit rank is exactly 10 and with at least one eligible target-allowed turn no later than the frozen current first-hit turn
cohort_contract.control_groups: all eligible target-allowed turns through and including the frozen current first-hit turn

training_contract.matrix: DMatrix with one binary relevance label per candidate row, 91-row query groups, and one weight per query group
training_contract.prediction: output_margin true over all 100 candidates for every held-out session and turn
training_contract.repeat: retrain all five outer models from scratch with identical inputs; require byte-identical float32 OOF score tensors and slot-10 proposal decisions

partition_weight_contract.session_base: each selected session contributes total pre-cohort weight one across its selected query groups
partition_weight_contract.cohort_balance: when both cohorts exist in a training partition, hard and control groups each contribute exactly one half of total weight
partition_weight_contract.final_scale: multiply all selected query-group weights so their arithmetic mean is one
partition_weight_contract.failure: fail closed if either cohort is absent, any session total is nonpositive, or final weights are nonfinite

stage_a_contract.proposal_action: focused slot-10 choice differs from the frozen current served choice and from the P11 incumbent
stage_a_contract.reachable_current_miss: on at least one eligible turn, proposal_action is true and the focused choice equals positive_index
stage_a_contract.reachable_fold_count: number of outer folds containing at least one reachable current-miss session
stage_a_contract.ungated_policy: apply every proposal_action as a supplement to the frozen current policy; this is diagnostic only and cannot be promoted without Stage B
stage_a_contract.gate: continue only when reachable current-miss sessions >=14 and reachable fold count >=3
stage_a_contract.target_boundary: positive_index is read only by cache-label construction and evaluator-side posthoc analysis, never by score projection or runtime features

environment_contract.cache_builder_and_evaluator: Python 3.11 environment because the frozen attribution module uses dataclass slots
